events.verdict: Murray (DEN) goes to, not through, DiVincenzo's (MIN) space as they two come together off-ball.
DiVincenzo (MIN) briefly grasps, and immediately releases, Murray's (DEN) jersey as they separate following the pick.
Randle (MIN) establishes his right foot as his pivot, which he moves prior to releasing his dribble.
Jokic (DEN) brings his arm toward Randle's (MIN) path and the contact off-ball is marginal.
Watson (DEN) applies his forearm to McDaniels' (MIN) side, and the contact during the shot attempt is marginal.

Replay review of the foul called on DiVincenzo (MIN) pursuant to a coach's challenge was deemed unsuccessful. DiVincenzo initiates contact with Jokic's (DEN) arm that affects his ability to maintain control of the ball.
Gobert (MIN) cleanly blocks Watson's (DEN) shot attempt.
McDaniels (MIN) contests Jones' (DEN) shot attempt, and the contact with his left arm is marginal.
Jokic (DEN) briefly grasps, and immediately releases, Gobert's (MIN) arm off-ball.
Gobert (MIN) establishes himself in Watson's (DEN) path prior to the contact.

Murray's (DEN) hand slides off the ball and he brushes Gobert's (MIN) arm as Gobert secures the rebound. Jokic (DEN) then dislodges the ball from Gobert, and any ensuing arm contact is considered incidental.
Murray (DEN) makes contact with Edwards' (MIN) arm that affects his jump shot attempt.
McDaniels (MIN) maintains a legal guarding position and Murray (DEN) throws the errant pass that DiVincenzo (MIN) cleanly intercepts.
McDaniels (MIN) commits a take foul on Jokic (DEN).
Murray (DEN) legally contests Edwards' (MIN) jump shot attempt.
Hardaway Jr. (DEN) and DiVincenzo (MIN) mutually engage and quickly disengage off-ball.
Murray (DEN) loses his balance on his own and not as a result of any contact from Randle (MIN).
Randle's (MIN) left hand makes more than marginal contact with Murray's (DEN) body on the perimeter.
McDaniels (MIN) legally contests Jokic's (DEN) shot attempt.
Gobert (MIN) establishes himself in Jones' (DEN) path prior to the contact.
Jones (DEN) directly contests Randle's (MIN) jump shot attempt, making legal, incidental contact to Randle's hand after the release.
Gobert (MIN) deflects the ball away from Jokic (DEN).

Replay review of the foul called on Jokic (DEN) pursuant to a coach's challenge was deemed successful. Gobert (MIN) initiates contact to Jokic's arms that affects his ability to secure the pass from Murray (DEN). This is the first illegal contact on the play and occurs prior to any contact by Jokic to Gobert while the ball is loose.
Jokic (DEN) and Randle (MIN) mutually engage and disengage off-ball.
Jones (DEN) grazes Edwards' (MIN) arm as he defends the shot attempt.
Edwards (MIN) briefly grasps, and immediately releases, Jokic's (DEN) jersey during the pick.
Edwards (MIN) releases away from Murray (DEN) to receive the inbounds pass.
Jokic (DEN) initiates contact with Edwards' (MIN) arm that affects the pass attempt.
Watson (DEN) deflects the ball away from McDaniels (MIN).
McDaniels (MIN) initiates contact with Jokic's (DEN) arm that affects his ability to gain full control of the loose ball.

After the made basket, Edwards (MIN) interferes with the ball and dislodges it from Jokic (DEN) which prevents the ball from promptly being put back into play. This is the second delay of game violation on the Timberwolves and it results in a delay of game technical foul.
DiVincenzo (MIN) does not give Jokic (DEN) the opportunity to avoid contact when receiving the pass, and a non-shooting personal foul is correctly assessed.
Edwards (MIN) is assessed an unsportsmanlike technical foul.
Edwards (MIN) is assessed a second unsportsmanlike technical foul and is ejected from the game.
Hardaway Jr. (DEN) legally contests McDaniels' (MIN) jump shot attempt.
DiVincenzo (MIN) and Murray (DEN) briefly engage and disengage during the inbound.
Hyland (MIN) commits a take foul on Watson (DEN).
Murray (DEN) legally contests DiVincenzo's (MIN) shot attempt.
DiVincenzo (MIN) brings his hand toward the ball and the contact with Jokic (DEN) is marginal.
Hyland (MIN) commits a take foul on Jokic (DEN).
Jones (DEN) makes contact with Hyland's (MIN) arm that affects his jump shot attempt.
Hyland's (MIN) free throw attempt does not make contact with the rim.
DiVincenzo (MIN) grabs Jokic's (DEN) arm and affects his ability to get to the pass.
